admitted_consumer: Y0 Gridline Interface / Inference Studio desktop surface

Y0_may_consume: runtime.authority and authority_detail for display labels
governance.* string values for display labels
privacy.* string values for display labels
Y0_must_not: Read raw runtime ledgers directly (runtime_execution_ledger.jsonl, etc.)
Read PostgreSQL domain tables, materialized views, or private X1 modules directly
Call RiggedMlxEngine, ModelPoolManager, RiggedCacheAuthority, or ToolExecutionBridge directly
Execute tool proposals or modify tool state
Bind or unbind session context on the bridge
Modify scheduler state (enqueue, admit, complete, fail, cancel)
Modify cache entries or eviction policy
Claim capability support that the projection marks as deferred or pending
Present provisional streaming tokens as verified before terminal evidence emission
Read raw prompt contexts or model output text from the evidence ledgers

streaming_state_display.terminal_completed: Show completed output with green check
streaming_state_display.terminal_failed: Show 'Error' with red indicator and error message
streaming_state_display.evidence_unavailable: Show 'Evidence Unavailable' with warning icon and tooltip explaining provenance gap

tool_state_display.full_execution: Show 'Tool Execution: Active' with session context indicator
tool_state_display.stateless_preflight_only: Show 'Tool Execution: Preflight Only' with disabled/ghosted icon

privacy_display.cache_persistence_opt_in: Show 'SSD Cache: Setup Required' link to settings

agent_loop_display.completed: Show completed output with green check
agent_loop_display.loop_limit_reached: Show 'Max turns reached' with amber indicator
agent_loop_display.evidence_degraded: Show warning icon with tooltip explaining evidence gap

shutdown_display.degraded_shutdown_active_generations_rem: Show 'Shutdown: Active generations may have been interrupted' warning

stream_terminal_evidence_display.degraded: Amber warning 'Some stream terminal evidence incomplete'

prohibited_claims: Y0 MUST NOT claim that the runtime supports continuous batching — this is explicitly deferred
Y0 MUST NOT claim that the runtime supports structured JSON output — this is explicitly pending
Y0 MUST NOT claim that tool proposals form an iterative agent loop — the runtime is one-shot tool execution
Y0 MUST NOT claim that embeddings, reranking, or vision/VLM are supported — all are explicitly pending
Y0 MUST NOT claim that tool execution is available when session_context_bound is false
Y0 MUST NOT present provisional streaming tokens as evidence-backed verified output
Y0 MUST NOT read raw evidence ledgers, engine internals, or pool/cache internals directly
Y0 MUST NOT claim that the iterative agent loop supports continuous batching — scheduling is serialized FCFS
Y0 MUST NOT claim that the iterative agent loop supports more than max_tool_turns concurrent tool executions
Y0 MUST NOT claim that stream terminal evidence is complete when health shows degraded or unavailable
Y0 MUST NOT claim that shutdown was clean when drain_status shows degraded shut down active generations remain
Y0 MUST NOT read or invoke execute_local_agent_loop() directly — consume only through the typed projection
